dct_title_s: Earthquake impact mapping from drones in Gairagaun, Pubichauki rural municipality ward-3, Doti, Nepal (November 2022)
dct_description_sm: Earthquake impacts mapping from drone data in Nepal (Gairagaun, Pubichauki rural municipality ward-3, Doti) from GLOBHE Crowddroner. The dataset includes high-resolution actionable drone data showing the area impacted from the earthquakes of early November 2022.
